records.source: The full nightly clone downloaded 9.25 GiB. Adding ``--filter=blob:none`` to the shallow clone does not reduce the checkout: its object store is still 2032 MB. Git does not report lazy blob fetches, so no download total was measured. The nightly tracked tree is a 958 MB checkout (measured 2026-10-20), excluding Git history. Download sizes and times vary with the branch.
records.translation: nightly 的完整克隆下载了 9.25 GiB。向浅克隆添加 ``--filter=blob:none`` 不会缩小检出文件：其 Git 对象存储仍占用 2032 MB。Git 不报告按需延迟获取的对象，因此没有测得下载总量。nightly 的版本控制文件检出后占用 958 MB（2026-10-20 测得），不含 Git 历史。下载大小和耗时随分支而变化。
